open_points.subject: trial and admission input materialization
open_points.text: Each case, in corpus order, is one call of `capability:sandbox.execute_function` with the implementation's code, the case's inputs and the contract's bounds
open_points.question: Which module reads the bytes named by each trial case's StoredValue and file-fixture references, through which capability, and passes the decoded values and file bytes to the sandbox for try and admission executions?
options: `functions` calls `store.read_value_bytes` and materializes every case input before calling `sandbox.execute_function`
`sandbox.execute_function` accepts stored references and is given access to retrieve their bytes
TrialCase records embed the payloads passed to the sandbox
open_points.default_guess: `functions` calls `store.read_value_bytes`, decodes value-carriage bytes, and passes value payloads and file bytes to `sandbox.execute_function`.

open_points.subject: operation request input materialization
open_points.text: `capability:service_invoker.prepare_request` judges the instance, resolves the credential through `capability:installation.resolve_service_credential` and places the inputs
open_points.question: Which module retrieves the value and file payloads named by an operation element's StoredValue and SpooledFile references before `service_invoker.prepare_request`, especially on resume and startup recovery when no in-memory payload is available?
options: `effects` calls `store.read_value_bytes` for every referenced input and passes materialized payloads to `service_invoker.prepare_request`
`service_invoker` receives stored references and gains a store-reading capability
open_points.default_guess: `effects` calls `store.read_value_bytes` for the referenced values and files, decodes value carriage, and passes materialized inputs to `service_invoker.prepare_request`.

open_points.subject: installed-instance startup validation
open_points.text: a manifest record that cannot be read or fails a check of the record itself (A08 rule 5) stops the start naming it
open_points.question: Which record-level A08 rule 5 checks are performed at startup, and over which capability entries, when `check_installed_instances` has no proposed operation name or proposed ports to validate?
options: Validate only the service-record and selected-instance facts needed to check credential-header collisions
Validate the record-level syntax of every capability entry in the service record
Choose one capability entry by an additional rule and apply its record checks
open_points.default_guess: Validate only the service record and selected-instance facts needed for the credential-header collision check, leaving operation-specific checks to proposal, acceptance and send.
